property_summary: For any admissible input, the reference C forwards the exact multiset/order of calls to the elements of _tos, which a recording helper can observe via accumulated (recipient, amount) pairs; the mutant M sends every call to _tos[0], so its observation differs from C for any input with at least two distinct recipients.
change_summary: Change the array element argument from _tos[i] to _tos[0], so all external calls target the first destination.
